summary: Tested new /api/validate-spec input gate. 8/8 backend pytest cases pass (empty/whitespace/<10 chars => too_short, real spec => valid, 'a chat app' => valid, 'what is the weather today' => classified_no, health OK, full audit SSE pipeline regression OK). 4/4 frontend E2E scenarios pass: (1) empty input blocked with 'Enter a system spec to run an audit.' - panels stay idle, button remains enabled, (2) 'what is the weather today' shows 'CHECKING INPUT...' briefly then blocks with correct descriptive spec-error, panels stay idle, button re-enabled, (3) 'a chat app' passes validation and all three panels (architect/chaos/hardened) reach loaded state, (4) recovery flow works - typing new spec clears spec-error and successful audit runs on gpt-4o-mini. No regression on default model path.
critical_code_review_comments: Validation reuses selected model — may hit premium (NVIDIA) key if user upgrades; fail-open policy correctly protects against timeout/errors so this is safe.
spec-error auto-clears on typing (good UX). Button 'disabled={running || validating}' correctly prevents double-submits during 1-2s validation window.
Backend endpoint correctly returns valid=true on fail-open paths (timeout/check_failed) preserving legitimate runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_validate_spec.py covers validate-spec endpoint (too_short/valid/classified_no) plus health and full /api/audit SSE regression. Frontend gate works end-to-end with gpt-4o-mini default.
